newsitem.title: FRANCE: List of possible Jospin ministers - papers.
newsitem.headline: List of possible Jospin ministers - papers.

text.p: Two French newspapers, left-wing Liberation and conservative Le Figaro, on Friday published lists of left-wing personalities it saw as possible ministers if Socialist party leader Lionel Jospin becomes prime minister after Sunday's second-round of parliamentary elections.

Jospin would become premier if the left won a majority and President Jacques Chirac asked him to form a government. French law leaves the choice of Prime Minister with the president, but Jospin is most widely expected to be called if the left wins.
The Socialist party has declined comment on the possible make-up of any Socialist-led government.
Following are the ministerial tips by the two newspapers.
-- Budget : Pierre Moscovici (Liberation, Figaro) or Francois Hollande (Liberation)
Rocard, Laurent Fabius, or Jack Lang (Liberation) Jacques
-- Defence : Paul Quiles (Liberation) Jean Pierre Chevenement (Figaro)
-- Transport and Environment : Marie-Christine Blandin, Dominique Voynet or Segolene Royal (Liberation) Claude Gayssot (Figaro)
-- Prime Minister's head of staff : Pascal Lamy (Figaro)
-- Head of socialist party succeeding Lionel Jospin : Daniel Vaillant (Liberation, Figaro), Francois Hollande (Figaro)

Le Figaro noted that Lionel Jospin said he would not include in his government people against which a legal investigation was pending, ruling out naming Robert Hue to a ministry. The only Communist seen by Liberation as a likely minister was Alain Bocquet, while Le Figaro mentioned Patrick Braouzec and Claude Gayssot as possible Communist ministers.
